item.title: Closure Order Granted On Newport Flat Over Drug-Related Anti-Social Behaviour
item.description: Police have secured a three-month closure order on a flat in Newport following ongoing drug-related anti-social behaviour.

item.title: Isle Of Wight County Record Office Reopens After Maintenance Works
item.description: The Isle of Wight County Record Office is set to reopen next week following a period of essential maintenance.

item.title: Bid To Transform Vacant Shanklin Town Centre Commercial Unit Into Flat
item.description: A vacant commercial premises in the centre of an Isle of Wight seaside town could be converted into an apartment.

item.title: Hovertravel Confirms Christmas And New Year Timetable Changes
item.description: Hovertravel has confirmed changes to its timetable over the Christmas and New Year period for 2025/26.

item.title: Isle Of Wight Political Leaders Call For May 2026 Elections To Go Ahead
item.description: Four Isle of Wight council group leaders have told Whitehall they do not support postponing the May 2026 local elections.

item.title: Isle Of Wight End Ventnor’s Unbeaten Run With 15-5 Victory
item.description: Ventnor’s perfect start to the Hampshire Counties Three season came to an end at the weekend.

item.title: Wightlink Helps Deliver 13 Million Christmas Items To The Island
item.description: Wightlink has been getting into the festive spirit this Christmas, partnering with Royal Mail to deliver an incredible 13 million items of post to the Isle of Wight.

item.title: Isle Of Wight Round Table Sleigh Runs Raise More Than £5,000 For Island Charities
item.description: The Isle of Wight Round Table’s annual Sleigh Runs, supported by WightFibre, have raised £5,134 for two Island charities.
